world_org_meetings.title: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
world_org_meetings.description: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 trade ministers are meeting in Wisconsin. Many will be discussing deals without their U.S. host
world_org_meetings.description: Most of the officials attending the G20 trade ministers' meeting in Milwaukee, Wisc., find themselves in challenging positions, largely because of U.S. President Donald Trump's global tariff agenda. It makes for a potentially unusual summit, with high-level meetings on the sidelines where different countries discuss plans to work around the host.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump’s tariffs loom over talks as G20 meets in US
world_org_meetings.description: Trade ministers of the Group of 20 are meeting in Milwaukee for two days of talks on Wednesday, but US President Donald Trump’s tariffs are expected to hang heavy over the talks. "Don't expect any breakthroughs," an analyst watching the event said.

world_org_meetings.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
world_org_meetings.description: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
world_org_meetings.description: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

diplomatic_visits.title: Europe Today: Russia hits Kyiv as Merz visits; Bolsonaro wins Brazil's first round election
diplomatic_visits.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's visit to Ukraine was met with Russian missiles as he pledged €1.3 billion to Kyiv. In Iran, the country's deputy foreign minister says Washington is reviewing Tehran’s proposal to end the war. And in Brazil, Bolsonaro wins Brazil's first round election.

diplomatic_visits.title: Malaysia’s Anwar to host Myanmar leader as repatriations near 10,000
diplomatic_visits.description: Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing to visit Kuala Lumpur 'in the next few days', Anwar Ibrahim says.

diplomatic_visits.title: France, Germany seek new EU rapid response tool against trade threats
diplomatic_visits.description: French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz on Monday announced they would develop a new legal tool to enable the EU to respond rapidly to trade wars or measures, such as dumping. While they did not say the proposal was a direct response to the actions of any particular country, it came days before EU Chief Ursula von der Leyen visits China to tackle trade frictions.

diplomatic_visits.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
diplomatic_visits.description: Footage shows a drone hitting the Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.

diplomatic_visits.title: Live: US wants to hold trilateral Ukraine talks with Russia by end of October, Zelensky says
diplomatic_visits.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Sunday that the US wants to broker a new round of talks with Ukraine and Russia on ending the war and hold it by the end of October. Earlier, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the city's Northern Bridge over the Dnipro River was again hit in a Russian attack during a visit by German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Follow our liveblog for all the latest developments.

elections.title: What are the US midterms? A simple guide
elections.description: US voters will head to the polls on 3 November in a ballot that could have a major impact on Donald Trump’s presidency.

elections.title: Watch: How Spain's housing crisis has resulted in an early general election
elections.description: A series of measures to tackle the housing crisis were defeated in parliament on Friday

elections.title: Dems have edge in midterms, poll shows. And, Paramount-Warner Bros. merger to close
elections.description: Polls are showing that Democrats have a clear advantage heading into the midterms, but that doesn't tell the whole story. And, today, a mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros. is set to close.

elections.title: Serbia ties overseas voting to local time, a move likely to spark backlash ahead of a key election
elections.description: Serbia's election commission has tied overseas voting hours to local time, affecting the Serbian diaspora's ability to vote in the upcoming election later this month

elections.title: Haiti postpones elections indefinitely as gang violence hampers preparations
elections.description: Haiti has indefinitely postponed elections scheduled for December and February, the electoral council said Tuesday, citing technical and operational requirements as gang violence continues to disrupt preparations. The delay leaves Haitians without a vote as authorities struggle to register voters and secure areas needed for the poll.
